prose: Latent.Space's AINews issue covers Claude Haiku 5.5, headlined as better than GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing, under the tagline 'yay small models'. The full issue could not be fetched, so this uses the headline and feed teaser.
Basis: headline and teaser. For the details of the launch see Anthropic's announcement, which gives Haiku 5.5 prices of $0.10 and $0.50 per million input and output tokens.
highlights: AINews: Haiku 5.5 beats GPT-6 Luna at the same price
Tagline: small models are the story
